rationale: The Court is likely to reverse on Rule 12 grounds, holding that allegations equally consistent with FDA-compliant skinny-label participation and foreseeable off-label use do not plausibly plead the specific, purposeful encouragement required for § 271(b) inducement. The majority will stress this is a narrow, pleadings-stage holding that preserves liability where a complaint plausibly alleges targeted promotional acts or directed communications aimed at the patented method.
